summary: Procedure to increase or decrease sanctioned electrical connected load for residential and commercial premises.

steps.title: Calculate total connected wattage
steps.description: Add wattage of new air-conditioners, motors, and appliances to determine required kW.

steps.title: Submit application on DISCOM portal
steps.description: Enter consumer CA number, current sanctioned load, requested load, and upload latest paid electricity bill.

steps.title: Wiring test certificate submission
steps.description: For load enhancements exceeding 5 kW, submit wiring test report signed by a licensed electrical contractor.

steps.title: Pay security & service charges
steps.description: Pay revised security deposit and meter upgrade fee via integrated net banking or bill desk.

steps.title: Meter replacement or breaker recalibration
steps.description: DISCOM linesman installs appropriate CT meter or adjusts MCB rating at property.
